mobbin:ed948f6a-ac7b-4742-add9-fafc58fda.summary: lands on the Incidents home showing an Ongoing sample incident with a sidebar badge, then switches Comments and Post-mortems tabs while a first-run setup checklist stays on screen.
steps: Incidents home with Ongoing sample and setup checklist
Incidents with comments, Ongoing and resolved rows
Post-mortems tab with Ongoing sample and checklist
steal: The home leads with the problem: an Ongoing incident with a red status, started-at time, and an Incidents sidebar badge of 1, with no All systems OK banner.
A setup checklist stays on screen with progress (5 of 6 left), a completed check, and the next step expanded with an Integrations button.
Report a new incident sits as a global main action beside search (screen 1).
avoid: The setup checklist takes about half the home while an incident is Ongoing, which clashes with show little, but precisely for faculty.
mobbin:ed948f6a-ac7b-4742-add9-fafc58fda.fit: Dashboard: the incident list and badge is the system-health problem surface and hands off room audio and video (AV) failures to Recording. The setup checklist is dashboard-only first-run for rooms, cameras, and users, not Reports.

mobbin:fc2ba92b-4783-43da-92c7-8acf4f16a.summary: opens an Ongoing unacknowledged incident, acknowledges it so the owner is shown, resolves it with an AI post-mortem, then reviews details and a timeline of acknowledge and resolve.
steps: Incident detail Ongoing, with Acknowledge as the main button
Acknowledged with owner shown and Resolve as the main button
Resolved with an AI post-mortem summary
Details plus acknowledge and resolve timeline
steal: The problem state offers Escalate and Acknowledge, and a green banner names who was escalated to (Alex), so who to call is explicit.
Acknowledge stamps the owner, and the main button flips to Resolve (screen 2).
Resolve closes the loop with duration, severity, team, and owner details, plus a timestamped timeline, as a guided ownership path rather than a help-article list.
These screens convey health by incident presence and sidebar count, without an at-a-glance All OK view.
mobbin:fc2ba92b-4783-43da-92c7-8acf4f16a.fit: Dashboard: Acknowledge then Resolve with a named owner is the system-health fix path for failed room self-tests. Deep device repair still hands off to Recording, while Who's on-call maps to User management and the sim-tech roster.
